title: The Flaky Swamp
tagline: The test that passes on your machine and fails in CI at 3 a.m.
teaches: Races, fixed waits, order dependence, and how to debug a failure you cannot reproduce
objectives: Name the four usual causes of a flaky test and spot which one you are looking at
Replace every fixed wait with an assertion that says what you are actually waiting for
Find the test that only passes because the test before it left something behind
Read a Playwright timeout message and get the cause out of it, not just the line number
Argue honestly about --reruns: what it buys, and what it hides
plannedChallenges: Spot the flake: three tests, one of them is lying
The sleep that works until it does not
The test that only passes second
Read the trace: where did the 30 seconds go?
Fix the race without adding a single wait
Boss: take a suite that fails one run in five and make it fail zero
